title: Trusted exact-diff semantic review gate bootstrap
objective: Introduce a base-controlled GitHub review gate that executes no pull-request-controlled code with repository secrets, sends the exact BASE..HEAD diff including deletions to genuine TypeSafe Jev, and records fail-closed machine-readable coverage and findings.

include: exact GitHub PR-head fetch with merge-base verification
pinned jev-review checkout and TypeSafe SDK
per-hunk Jev screening and severity-rated findings
exclude: candidate-controlled code execution in secret-bearing jobs

authority_delta.filesystem: Review tooling only; no Cotra runtime filesystem authority
authority_delta.network: Review-only pinned tool installation and TypeSafe API access
authority_delta.secrets: TYPESAFE_API_KEY is scoped to credential presence and base-controlled adapter execution only
authority_delta.privileged: No runtime authority; repository workflow governance changes

invariants: The workflow executing under pull_request_target is loaded from the base branch
The Jev adapter executed with TYPESAFE_API_KEY is extracted from the exact base SHA
The pull-request head is fetched only as Git data and is never checked out in the secret-bearing job
The reviewed range is exactly BASE_SHA..HEAD_SHA and the merge base equals BASE_SHA
Every changed-file hunk including deletions receives a genuine TypeSafe Jev screening judgment
Incomplete coverage, SDK errors, binary diffs, or severity-2/3 findings fail the gate
OCR executes only the checksum-pinned official Linux release binary and never executes candidate package scripts
No TypeSafe credential value is printed or persisted

acceptance.claim: A temporary exact-diff fixture containing a deleted file records the deleted path and complete 1/1 hunk coverage.
Workflow syntax proves pull_request_target, base checkout, exact PR-ref fetch, merge-base equality, and base-SHA adapter extraction.
Genuine local TypeSafe Jev reviews every exact bootstrap diff hunk with the SDK installed by pinned jev-review commit 31f89602797fb7bea007f8a480bf368bf564954e.
Pinned Alibaba OCR Delegation Mode executes against the exact bootstrap range and records selected/excluded files and rules.
Exact-head Windows, Ubuntu, Node, and Governance CI pass.
Independent security review finds no unresolved critical/high workflow or adapter finding.

done_when: The trusted base-controlled exact-diff review gate is merged with post-merge CI and becomes available to qualify SG-000008 without executing candidate code with TYPESAFE_API_KEY.
